name: Nebius Lappeenranta AI Factory / Pajarila data center campus
notes: City of Lappeenranta and Nebius: multibuilding AI data center campus in Pajarila, construction beginning spring 2026 in phases, first phase complete during 2027; full deployment 310 MW / ~USD 10bn investment. Municipal project page + operator release = A.

name: Pure DC SJK01 Seinajoki campus
notes: Pure DC describes Seinajoki SJK01 as its largest campus, scalable beyond 550 MW on ~370 acres; phase 1 underway with 110 MW leased (press reports Microsoft as tenant). Seinajoki city hosted a resident info session on the datacenter (Aug 2026), confirming municipal engagement.

name: Isojoki Pettenkangas data center project
notes: Trade press citing local reports: Isojoki municipality selling ~180 ha near Pettenkangas industrial area for a planned data center; construction could start Sep 2026, capacity not disclosed.

name: Compute Nordic Visulahti data center campus
notes: Mikkeli Development Miksei: Compute Nordic preparing a 200 MW data center campus in Visulahti with phased construction toward 2028; ~10 ha secured plus expansion options.

name: Regant Oy Visulahti data center
notes: Mikkeli/Miksei: city will lease Regant a five-hectare Visulahti plot with >24,000 sqm building rights for a planned large-scale data center; scope under design.

name: Aurora Core Technology Pellos AI data center
developer: Aurora Core Technology Oy; 3 E Network Technology Group
notes: Miksei: Aurora Core signed a 10-hectare Pellos land lease; initial 6 MW phase expected H2 2026, up to 50 MW grid connection possible over time.

name: Orka Technologies EcoSairila data center
notes: Miksei: Orka confirmed investment decision for a first 5 MW phase under an existing construction permit in EcoSairila; construction scheduled Q1 2026, initial go-live Q3 2026 (treat as under construction as of this pass).

name: XTX Markets Kajaani data center campus
notes: Invest in Kainuu/DCD: XTX Markets investing over EUR 1bn on a ~478-acre Kajaani campus; first data center totals three data halls and 22.5 MW IT power, completion/operation targeted 2026.

name: CSC Kajaani data center / LUMI AI Factory expansion
notes: CSC: Kajaani data center expanding to host LUMI-AI and LUMI-IQ, completion expected 2027; SRV responsible for LUMI AI Factory data center construction, operation expected spring 2027.

name: Google land acquisition leads (Kajaani, Vaala, Muhos)
notes: Yle reports Google planning data centers in Kajaani, Vaala and Muhos; directory reports Google acquired land in Kajaani and Muhos (Muhos is in North Ostrobothnia - see note there). No capacity or firm schedule. Planned lead only.

name: Kuhmo data center feasibility project
notes: Yle: Kuhmo reserved a study phase with a Norwegian property developer for a potential data center requiring an estimated 40 MW or more; investor and final feasibility open.

name: QTS Forssa data center campus (Pikku-Muolaan Kehitys Oy)
developer: QTS Data Centers / Blackstone (SPV Pikku-Muolaan Kehitys Oy)
notes: QTS official page: first Finland campus on a 150 ha site in Forssa (Ratasmaeki, >100 ha preliminary agreement with the city); YVA in progress - arviointiselostus (EIA report) on public display 23.2-31.3.2026 at ymparisto.fi/Forssan-datakeskus-YVA, responsible party Pikku-Muolaan Kehitys Oy (Brunswick Real Estate). Zoning changes underway.

name: Hameenlinna MORE Industrial Park data center campus
notes: Trade press: Hameenlinna made plot reservation agreement for three MORE Industrial Park plots totaling 149,795 sqm enabling up to 120 MW while the developer seeks an experienced operator.

name: Fortum / City of Jyvaskyla Seppaelaenkangas data center complex
notes: Fortum and Jyvaskyla signed a letter of intent to develop/market a data center complex of at least 20 ha in Seppaelaenkangas; operator and capacity not disclosed. Planned lead.

name: Google Hamina data center campus
notes: Google official page: Hamina campus opened 2011 (former Summa paper mill), seventh data center announced 2024; EUR 1bn expansion announced (total investment >EUR 4.5bn) with first off-site heat recovery project feeding Haminan Energia district heating (target ~80% of local heat demand). Capacity not disclosed.

name: Hyperco / TikTok Kouvola-Koria data center (Project Clover)
notes: TikTok: Hyperco building a Kouvola data center (Project Clover) under ~EUR 1bn investment; cornerstone ceremony held and construction begun. YVA page (Kouvolan datakeskus, Hyperco Data Systems Oy): operational phase ~100 MW IT, total electrical ~130 MW, backup-generator fuel power ~550 MW. Construction contractor Teraselementti involved in a 28,000 sqm phase.

name: Hyperco Koria second data center
notes: Trade press: Hyperco received permission for a second Koria data center building of ~56,670 sqm, ~100 MW IT capacity and ~130 MW total electrical capacity; adjacent phase to the TikTok/Project Clover site.

name: DayOne Kouvola campus
notes: DayOne official Finland page: Finland platform totals 281 MW across Lahti and Kouvola; with Lahti described separately as 128 MW, implied Kouvola component is ~153 MW (inferred from public statements).

name: FCDC Rovaniemi / Hietavaara data center
notes: Trade press citing local reports: FCDC Corp Oy plans a 500 MW data center at Hietavaara ~10-15 km from Rovaniemi with 180,000 sqm building rights; construction targeted 2027, operations ~2029.

name: Polarnode Keminmaa data center (Mykaenmaan datakeskus)
notes: Polarnode lists a Keminmaa project (Sea Lapland); the project was renamed Mykaenmaan datakeskus and its asemakaava OAS (zoning participation/assessment plan) was presented in Keminmaa June 2026 - municipal planning in progress; capacity not public.

name: Polarnode Nokia data center campus (Juhansuo)
notes: Polarnode and City of Nokia agreed on a Juhansuo industrial plot; planned first phase 30 MW on 5.5 ha, later expansion potential up to 100 MW.

name: FCDC Valkeakoski data center
notes: Aggregator lists FCDC planning a large-scale Valkeakoski facility in Mahlianmaa near Highway 130; FCDC site confirms it develops ready-to-build campuses but no project detail exposed - C-grade lead.

name: Glesys Tampere data center
notes: Glesys official page markets an operating Tampere data center (formerly Verne/Ficolo 'The Rock'/'The Air'); DCD reported Verne sold Tampere and Pori facilities to Glesys in 2025.

name: Mustanlahden datakeskus (Maenttae-Vilppula)
notes: Project site: planning a data center next to Mustanlahti industrial area in Maenttae-Vilppula (Pirkanmaa) together with Finsilva; YVA procedure initiated to clarify preconditions. Early planning stage; operator/SPV and capacity not yet public.

name: FCDC Vaasa data center campus (Kuriiritie 7)
notes: City of Vaasa: building permit for Kuriiritie 7 approved 10 Dec 2025; ~66,000 sqm campus in GigaVaasa/Laajametsae, construction estimated 2026, operation 2028-2029.

name: Microsoft GigaVaasa potential datacenter development (Vaasa/Mustasaari)
notes: Microsoft and Vaasa: preliminary agreement for ~190 ha in the GigaVaasa area (~2/3 in Vaasa, ~1/3 in Mustasaari) to support potential datacenter development; no permits or construction yet - planned.

name: YIT Kontiolahti Vellamo data center campus
notes: Kontiolahti municipality official page: cooperation with YIT for a ~25 ha plot reservation in the Vellamo business area (Lehmo, north of Joensuu); YIT to refine plans and find implementation partners. Capacity not disclosed.

name: Kitee Puhos data center
notes: Business Joensuu (city development company): a new data center is being built at Kitee's Puhos industrial area with an estimated 50-100 permanent jobs; operator name and capacity not yet disclosed.

name: Glesys / Trevian Campus Oulu
notes: Glesys announced an agreement with Trevian for an AI-ready modular data center campus in Oulu with long-term expansion potential up to 300 MW.

name: AmpTank Utajarvi hyperscale data center
notes: AmpTank announced a first hyperscale project in Utajarvi with 100 MW immediately available plus backup battery storage; DCD places it in Mustikkakangas industrial area outside Oulu.

name: Pyhajoki data center (YVA concluded)
developer: Pyhajoki data center project (SPV not confirmed this pass)
notes: Large data center planned in Keskikylae, Pyhajoki near the main grid; YVA reasoned conclusion (perusteltu paatelma) issued on the EIA report; preparatory construction works reported (Kaleva); land esisopimus with Pyhajoki municipality Nov 2024, connection intended to Valkeuden saehkoeasema. Methodology notes the YVA discloses IT-teho/kokonaissaehkoeteho; values not re-verified this pass (capacity null).

name: Meta / Valoa Networks Herva data center, Ii
developer: Valoa Networks Oy (Meta Platforms subsidiary); Municipality of Ii
notes: YVA page (Hervan datakeskus, Ii): project in Herva village ~35 km NE of Ii center, just south of Fingrid's Herva substation under construction; YVA comment period ran to 20.7.2026. Ii municipality and Valoa Networks Oy (Meta Platforms subsidiary) developing a large data center area. NEW lead this pass; capacity not disclosed.

name: YIT Liminka Kivimaki data center and solar parks
notes: Trade press: 30-hectare data center planned with two solar parks at Kivimaki farm in Liminka near Oulu; capacity not disclosed.

name: YIT Kuopio Hepomaki data center project
notes: YIT proposed reserving ~45 ha in Hepomaki, Kuopio for a new data center; Kuopio plan report: city board approved the YIT area reservation agreement 19 Nov 2025.

name: Polarnode Kuopio Mustakorpi data center
notes: Polarnode: Mustakorpi project (between Hiltulanlahti and Pellesmaeki) would start at ~50 MW with grid enabling campus expansion up to 250 MW; construction-ready goal during 2027.

name: Helios Iisalmi Tervamaeki data center
notes: City of Iisalmi: Helios started planning a data center in Tervamaeki and submitted a zoning initiative; Yle reported more than 100 ha reserved.

name: DayOne Lahti Kiverioe hyperscale data center
notes: Lahti city announced a EUR 1.2bn DayOne data center in Kiverioe; SRV announced construction start with 2027 operations; DayOne states 128 MW total potential with an initial 50 MW building (trade reports TikTok as anchor tenant).

name: Polarnode Heinola Vierumaeki data center
notes: Polarnode: preparing ~40 MW data center on an 11-hectare industrial plot in northern Vierumaeki Business Park, aiming for construction readiness in early 2026.

name: FCDC Lahti data center (Ilmarisentie)
notes: DCD reported FCDC acquired a 10-hectare Lahti plot from city premises company Spatium for EUR 6m with plans for a 100 MW facility; aggregator places it at Ilmarisentie 3.

name: ASP DC Pori campus / Ecogrid Energy Park
notes: Business Pori/DCD: ASP DC entered a definitive agreement to acquire the 37-hectare CompassForge Pori project with 300-400 MW modular capacity; construction set for 2026, first commercial operation early 2027.

name: Polarnode Pori Honkaluoto data center project (divested)
notes: City/Business Pori described a 26-hectare Honkaluoto project over 100 MW; Polarnode later announced an agreement to sell the shovel-ready, grid-ready project to an undisclosed European operator.

name: Glesys Pori data center
notes: Glesys official page markets its operational Pori facility; DCD reported Verne sold Finnish operations including Pori to Glesys in Oct 2025.

name: E-Heat Oy Kankaanpaeae heat-reuse data center
notes: NEW: 2 MW data center started June 2026 at Vatajankoski power plant, Kankaanpaeae (Satakunta), consisting of 12 water-cooled server cabinets (E-Heat Oy); waste heat recycled into district heating, covering ~20% of Kankaanpaeae's district heat demand. Small but real operational facility - primary utility source.

name: Microsoft Southern Finland datacenter region (Espoo/Kirkkonummi/Vihti)
notes: Microsoft building a Southern Finland datacenter region across Espoo (Hepokorpi, ~28 ha), Kirkkonummi and Vihti (Nummela, ~60 ha); Espoo land sale 2023 and Hepokorvenkallio asemakaava legally in force; Kirkkonummi phase 1 rakentamislupa granted with phase 2 pending; district heating integration with Fortum (Espoo/Kirkkonummi/Kauniainen, serving ~250,000 residents). Multi-site campus - count as one region program with three municipalities.

name: Verne Maentsaelae Kapuli data center campus
notes: Verne marked construction start for the first 70 MW of its Maentsaelae Kapuli-area campus (~10 ha, AI/HPC-oriented, renewable energy, planned waste-heat reuse); Nivos (DSO) confirms a second large Maentsaelae datacenter multiplying electricity transmission and enabling wider waste-heat use.

name: Nebius Maentsaelae AI data center
notes: Nebius announced (2024) tripling its Maentsaelae datacenter to 75 MW and confirmed (2026) the expansion to 75 MW was completed earlier in the year; the site originated as Yandex's Finnish datacenter producing district heat for Maentsaelae.

name: DayOne Nurmijaervi data center project
notes: DayOne announced early-stage Nurmijaervi plans subject to approvals/permits, with tentative phased development potential up to 560 MW total grid power.

name: Equinix Helsinki data centers (five facilities)
notes: Equinix official Finland pages: five Finland data centers in Helsinki, about 7,750 sqm of colocation space (HE1-HE7 facility lineage).

name: Telia Helsinki Data Center (Valimotie)
notes: Telia official page: Helsinki data center at Valimotie 3-5, Pitaejaenmaeki (~15,000 sqm data hall, 24 MW IT per directory); opened 2018, DCD reported potential scale toward 100 MW IT load; waste heat feeds Helen district heating (Nordics' largest open datacenter per Helen).

name: Jaervenpaeae palvelinkeskus (data center) YVA project
developer: Jaervenpaeae data center project (SPV not public)
notes: NEW: YVA program for a planned data center in the Waertsilae district of Jaervenpaeae (Uusimaa) was on public display from Feb 2026 (YVA-ohjelma with VE0/VE1/VE2 alternatives); city/business development pages cite at least 40 direct high-skill jobs. Operator/SPV and capacity not yet public.

name: Hetzner Data Center Park Helsinki (Tuusula)
notes: Hetzner operates its Finnish data center park in Tuusula (Data Center Park Helsinki) - methodology seed; not re-verified in depth this pass (grade B).

name: Digita Pasila data center
notes: Digita Data Centers operates a Pasila (Helsinki) facility with strong interconnection/IXP role - methodology seed; not re-verified in depth this pass (grade B).

name: atNorth Finland data centers (FIN02/FIN04)
notes: atNorth lists Finnish data center facilities (Helsinki-area FIN02/FIN04 naming); methodology seed - capacity and exact addresses to verify with municipal permits (grade B).

name: Elisa Raisio (Turku) data center
notes: Aggregators list an operational Elisa facility serving the Turku/Raisio market; no primary project page or capacity detail found this pass - C-grade lead pending operator/municipal confirmation.
